svg.text: Page table physical base addr Unused
Available for OS (page tablelocation on disk)

g.text: Child page table present in physical memory (1) or not (0).
R/W Read-only or read-write access permission for all reachable pages.
U/S User or supervisor (kernel) mode access permission for all reachable pages.
WT Write-through or write-back cache policy for the child page table.
CD Caching disabled or enabled for the child page table.

svg.text: Reference bit (set by MMU on reads and writes, cleared by software).

g.text: Page size either 4 KB or 4 MB (deﬁned for level 1 PTEs only).
Base addr 40 most significant bits of physical base address of child page table.
XD Disable or enable instruction fetches from all pages reachable from this PTE.
